name: Shae Féarglas
source:
Shae was the child of loyalist servants who attended to the royal family of Tír na nÓg, and were expected to follow the same path when they came of age. Yet, life has a funny way of turning duty on its head. During the War of the Courts, Shae's family served at the Crown Princess' stronghold, and were present during the fateful attack that led to the princess vanishing without a trace. Shae was the last person to see her, and indeed even helped her escape the stronghold during the fray, but sadly the two unlikely friends were separated. While the Seelie Court believed the princess to be dead, Shae decided to enlist as a soldier in hopes of finding her behind enemy lines.

These days, Shae now lives a quiet life of isolation as a guard, but secretly they have never ceased in their search for the Lost Seelie Princess, even in the face of ridicule... and perhaps even their own peril. After all, many in the Seelie Court have gotten used to the new, post-war administration, and don't take kindly to Shae's propensity for stirring up long dead trouble.
